schema_extensions.tool.apmx: max axial depth of cut (in) printed in the catalog for the part; null if not published
schema_extensions.tool.programming_radius: vendor's 'theoretical radius' / defined radius rp for CAM programming (in); tool.corner_radius is null because the vendor publishes no separate corner radius
schema_extensions.tool.max_ramp_deg: max ramp angle, null where unpublished
schema_extensions.cut.ap_min / cut.ap_max: when the vendor gives a range of axial depth, ap is the upper bound and ap_min the lower bound (in)
schema_extensions.cut.ae_min_over_D: when the vendor gives a minimum radial engagement ('>= .65 x Dia'), ae is that minimum and cut.ae_is_minimum is true
schema_extensions.cut.vf_ipm / cut.rpm: published feed rate and rpm where the vendor prints them
